sloka: तन्निवर्तय लङ्केशं द्दण्डमेतं समुद्यतम् ।सत्यं च मां कुरुष्वाद्य लोकांस्त्वं यद्यवेक्षसे ।। ७.२२.४६ ॥
transliteration: tannivartaya laṅkeśaṁ ddaṇḍametaṁ samudyatam ।satyaṁ ca māṁ kuruṣvādya lokāṁstvaṁ yadyavekṣase ।। 7.22.46 ॥

translations.english: If this demon (Ravana) does not die even after this rod has fallen, or if Ravana dies, then in either case, it would be a falsehood (regarding the boon of immortality).
